name: prototype

summary.en: Matt Pocock’s skill for building a throwaway prototype to answer one design question about logic, state or UI.
summary.zh: Matt Pocock 的 Skill：做一个用完即弃的原型，只回答一个关于逻辑、状态或界面的设计问题。

upstreamDescription: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.
